bio: Enter Manao, and you will be greeted with exotic vibes bolstered by seek décor and an array of art objects brought directly from Thailand. Its prix-fixe menus consist of multiple dishes in small portions, allowing guests to enjoy a variety of plates in one meal. The kitchen does an excellent job of presenting authentic Thai cuisine with its characteristic spiciness. Another appeal of this spot is that the meat and seafood are grilled to order over charcoal. Manao means “lime” in Thai, and its fare is as refreshing as its name....
